# The NCA Hub — llms.txt
# https://www.thencahub.com

## What This Site Is
The NCA Hub is an NCA exam preparation platform for internationally trained
lawyers seeking Canadian law qualification through the National Committee on
Accreditation (NCA).

## Who It Is For
- Lawyers trained in India (Indian LLB graduates) — the largest audience segment
- Lawyers trained in the UK (LLB, LLM, GDL, SQE)
- Lawyers trained in Nigeria, Jamaica, the Philippines, Pakistan, and other common law jurisdictions
- Any foreign-qualified lawyer who needs to pass NCA challenge exams to practise law in Canada

## Important: NCA Subject Assignment
- The NCA assigns the SAME 5 mandatory subjects to ALL internationally trained lawyers:
  Administrative Law, Constitutional Law, Criminal Law, Professional Responsibility, Foundations of Canadian Law
- Additional elective subjects (Contracts, Torts, Property Law, etc.) are assigned based on each
  candidate's INDIVIDUAL degree assessment — not by nationality
- Elective assignments vary by person, not by country of qualification

## What It Offers
- Concise study notes: under 80 pages per NCA exam subject,
  tabbed and built to be usable inside a 3-hour open-book exam
- Answer templates for exam structure
- Free NCA Readiness Score — a 5-question subject-specific quiz
- Free chapter downloads for each of the 5 mandatory subjects
- Guidance on the CPLED Legal Research and Writing (LRW) course
- Free elective exam guides (Contracts, Torts, Property Law, Business Organisations, Civil Procedure)
- Province-specific qualification guides (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta)
- 35+ free blog articles covering NCA process, strategy, and subject-specific guidance

## Subjects Covered
Mandatory (same for all candidates):
- Administrative Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Constitutional Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Criminal Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Foundations of Canadian Law (NCA challenge exam) — notes available
- Professional Responsibility (NCA challenge exam) — notes available

Electives (assigned per individual degree assessment):
- Contracts — free exam guide available at /blog/nca-contracts-exam-guide/
- Torts — free exam guide available at /blog/nca-torts-exam-guide/
- Property Law — free exam guide available at /blog/nca-property-law-exam-guide/
- Business Organisations — free exam guide available at /blog/nca-business-organisations-exam-guide/
- Civil Procedure — free exam guide available at /blog/nca-civil-procedure-exam-guide/

Other:
- Legal Research and Writing / LRW (CPLED course guidance) — guide available at /blog/nca-lrw-guide/
